faces.description: Arm Numeric with x0 and x2. Roll again to gain 1 Gold and blank this face for the fight.
faces.name: Gambler's Coin

faces.description: Gain a personal backstab marker through next round. Your next adjacent Attack from below the north-facing boss repeats once, with fresh Numeric rolls for each resolution.
faces.name: Weak Point

faces.description: Copy another visible immediate hero face. Select its hero and die; resolve the copy now. No setup/copy loops.
faces.name: Conjure

faces.description: Choose a hero and a specific Blank slot: install Recovery there. Recovery heals Numeric at range 1. After two placements this face becomes Blank.
faces.name: Blessing of Recovery

faces.description: Prototype: when rolled, gain 1 Action Reroll (cap 1). The bank begins with 1, so save this for replenishment.
faces.name: Clairvoyance

faces.description: Tabletop variant: your next Numeric damage this turn gets +1. No party-wide buff or backlash.
faces.name: Forgotten Strength

faces.description: Heal another hero within 3 for Numeric, then pass this face to a Blank on that hero. No self-target; the source becomes Blank.
faces.name: Passing Grace

faces.description: Tabletop variant: rotate another unresolved die to one of its installed non-penalty faces and immediately resolve that result.
faces.name: Borrow Shape

faces.description: Roll and store one ordinary Numeric value. It replaces your next Numeric roll. A second stored value is not allowed.
faces.name: Numeric Echo

faces.description: Choose a boss die and face. Until your next turn, that face rolls as Bound (no action); you suffer 1 normal damage each time it triggers.
faces.name: Lethargic Bind

faces.description: Heal another hero within 3 for Numeric, minimum 1. Cannot target yourself. Gambler x0 stays zero.
faces.name: Restore

faces.description: Your next Numeric roll this turn treats Blank as 1, then this benefit ends.
faces.name: Focus Numeric

faces.description: Mark the boss until round end. The next damaging Attack when it has zero Block adds 1 damage, then removes the mark.
faces.name: Mark Prey

faces.description: After all your other non-Blank dice resolve, deal 1 unavoidable damage to the boss. Prototype range: visible anywhere.
faces.name: Last Word

faces.description: Skip another unresolved non-Blank die, then repeat one already spent immediate face. Copy/repeat faces cannot chain into themselves.
faces.name: Second Chance

faces.description: Roll this die until an Attack appears, then resolve it twice at random legal adjacent units, including allies. No Attack on this die: no effect.
faces.name: Spiral Instability

faces.description: Channel: after maintaining at turn start, each future Blank grants 1 Block and each non-Blank adds Numeric +1 for that turn, capped +2. HP damage breaks it, deals 2 more and leaves a Red Tile. Prototype limit: one active Channel per hero; a second cannot replace it.
faces.name: Contained Power

faces.description: Prototype on resolution: choose an unresolved Blank die, then choose an installed ability on it and resolve that face. This face becomes a locked Red Tile for the fight.
faces.name: Corruption Conversion

faces.description: Empower the next two Attacks against the boss by +1 damage. After the second, take 1 unavoidable damage.
faces.name: Blood Bargain

faces.description: Reaction when personally targeted: force a different legal adjacent hero to be targeted. With no alternative the original target remains.
faces.name: Target Override

faces.description: Your next Attack or Defense this turn gets +2 value. At your next turn, the first such face gets −2 value (minimum 0).
faces.name: Debt

faces.description: Prototype resolution choice: modify another unresolved Attack/Defense. d6: 1 gives −1, 2–4 gives +1, 5 gives Pierce 2 (Defense +2 Block), 6 repeats an Attack or doubles Defense Block.
faces.name: Ill Omen

faces.description: Prototype Channel: gain 2 Block. While maintained, explicitly preserve existing Block at turn start and add 1 (cap 8). Any HP loss or 2 cumulative Block lost before your next turn breaks this Channel. End voluntarily to reroll the die. Prototype limit: one active Channel per hero; a second cannot replace it.
faces.name: Stonewake

faces.description: Prototype: resolve another rolled Step, Stride or Guard now; store it as a Reaction until the next shared roll. Movement reaction steps 1; Defense grants 1 Block.
faces.name: Oath of Smoke

faces.description: Choose a Blank on one of your dice and replace it with Bone for this fight. Bone grants 1 Block, then optionally steps 1.
faces.name: Bone Mutation

faces.description: Adjacent unit: roll Numeric and deal that much damage.
faces.name: Strike Numeric

faces.description: Target a visible unit within 2. Damage capped at 2 per resolution, including Mark Prey; the mark is consumed on a damaging hit. Units block sight; no diagonal corner shooting.
faces.name: Short Shot

faces.description: Catalog variant: adjacent Numeric Attack. If at least 2 HP damage is dealt, gain that much Block.
faces.name: Hooked Slash

faces.description: Adjacent Numeric Attack. Bypass 1 Block without destroying the bypassed portion.
faces.name: Piercing Thrust

faces.description: Adjacent Numeric Attack. A second enemy adjacent to that target takes 1. This encounter has only one enemy.
faces.name: Cleave

faces.description: Prototype: adjacent Numeric Attack; add 1 when standing below the north-facing boss. Rear means its southern edge.
faces.name: Flanking Blow

faces.description: Adjacent Numeric Attack. If you break existing Block and deal HP damage, delay an upcoming boss activation one initiative slot when possible; normal initiative returns next round.
faces.name: Break Rhythm

faces.description: Prototype adjacent Numeric Attack. After dealing HP damage, once per hero turn, fill one Blank on this die with Engrave, up to 3 copies. Never overwrites abilities. 3 copies: +1 damage; no further scaling.
faces.name: Engrave

faces.description: Gain Block equal to a Numeric roll.
faces.name: Guard Numeric

faces.description: If at zero Block, gain 3; otherwise gain 1.
faces.name: Brace Hero

faces.description: Reaction when an ally within 2 is attacked: give both that hero and yourself 1 Block before the hit.
faces.name: Shield Wall

faces.description: Reaction when another hero is attacked: become the target if adjacent to the boss. You must be a legal target.
faces.name: Taunt

faces.description: Reaction before a lethal Attack: stay at 1 HP instead, gain Stunned, then blank this face. Prototype sets aside your first available result.
faces.name: Defy Death

faces.description: Gain Damage Reduction 1 and Weakness 1 until your next turn. Unavoidable damage bypasses reduction.
faces.name: Bulwark

faces.description: Reaction during a boss Attack: deal your actual HP damage taken this round to the boss (cap 3), then blank this face. If unused, take 1 unavoidable damage at next turn start.
faces.name: Echo of Pain

faces.description: Channel: at each maintained turn start, heal 1 if no HP damage got through. HP damage breaks this Channel and blanks it. Prototype limit: one active Channel per hero; a second cannot replace it.
faces.name: Last Pulse

faces.description: Gain Numeric +1 Block. Prototype timing: at your turn end, lose 1 HP if Block remains.
faces.name: Black Oath

faces.description: Prototype: gain Numeric Block. Until your next turn, an adjacent attacker causing HP loss receives Weakness 1 until its turn ends.
faces.name: Wither Ward

faces.description: Prototype: gain Numeric Block, then burn up to 2 Block; each deals normal damage to every adjacent unit, including allies. Choose how much to burn.
faces.name: Ember Burst

faces.description: Tabletop variant: leap up to 2 orthogonally over units, never land occupied. If ending adjacent to the boss, your next Numeric damage this turn gets +1.
faces.name: Leap of Echoes

faces.description: Gain 1 Block and optionally step 1.
faces.name: Bone

faces.description: Heal yourself or an adjacent hero for Numeric.
faces.name: Recovery

faces.description: Inert, non-rerollable, not a Blank, locked for this encounter.
faces.name: Red Tile

faces.description: Slip through ash: move up to 2 orthogonal spaces, turning allowed, then gain 1 Block. Cannot pass through units.
faces.name: Ashstep

faces.description: Swap positions with a living standing ally within 3 and clear sight. Both heroes gain 1 Block. Cannot swap with the boss or a Downed hero.
faces.name: Oathbound Exchange
